### Where it’s sized

When the context is created. `llama_init_from_model()` reads `n_ctx` from the context parameters and allocates the cache for that many tokens up front, for every layer. Nothing grows later.

### What it costs on this Mac

| Window | Cache, 8-bit | With weights |
|---|---:|---:|
| 8K | 0.2 GB | 12.3 GB |
| 32K | 0.6 GB | 12.7 GB |
| 128K | 2.4 GB | 14.5 GB |

Apogee picks 32K on this machine and keeps the cache 8-bit. `apogee models info gpt-oss-20b` prints the same arithmetic.
